The backend for LWJGL 2: its natives and its snapshot backend.
Learn: [LWJGL 2 backend](/build/backends/lwjgl2/).

| Type | Kind | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| [`Lwjgl2Backend`](/reference/lwjgl2/lwjgl2backend/) | class | The backend for LWJGL 2, which draws with OpenGL into the `Display` and plays sound with the OpenAL of LWJGL 2. |
| [`Lwjgl2Natives`](/reference/lwjgl2/lwjgl2natives/) | class | Extracts the native libraries of LWJGL 2 and OpenAL into the cache folder, unless the application already provides them. |
| [`Lwjgl2SnapshotBackend`](/reference/lwjgl2/lwjgl2snapshotbackend/) | class | The snapshot backend of LWJGL 2, which renders in an offscreen OpenGL context. |
